assessor.in_short: The TV looked up Samba TV's content-recognition service 96 times in a day. That is consistent with the TV identifying what is on screen and reporting it. It also looked up OzTAM, an audience-measurement company, 412 times, and an advertising service that Pi-hole blocked every time.

what_it_is.text: A smart TV used for streaming and broadcast catch-up.
basis: The device name says it is a TV.
It describes itself as a Sony BRAVIA over UPnP.
Most named lookups are for ABC iview and Netflix.

who_it_talks_to.meaning: Samba TV matches what is on screen against known programmes and adverts.

who_it_talks_to.observation: Looked up 412 times; none were blocked.
who_it_talks_to.meaning: OzTAM measures Australian TV audiences for broadcasters.

who_it_talks_to.observation: Looked up 58 times; all 58 were blocked.
who_it_talks_to.meaning: Apps on the TV request adverts.

what_it_sends.observed: Most of the volume went to the TV, which is consistent with streaming video.
what_it_sends.unknown: Where the outgoing bytes went, and what they contained, cannot be told from this data.

concerns.title: Viewing recognised by Samba TV
concerns.fact: The TV looked up a Samba TV content-recognition name 96 times, and 56 of those lookups were answered.
concerns.inference: The TV's built-in viewing-data feature is probably on and reporting what is watched.
concerns.mitigation: Turn off viewing information or content recognition in the TV's privacy settings, then block samba.tv in Pi-hole.
concerns.verify: Check that the Pi-hole query log shows no further answered Samba TV lookups after a day of normal use.

concerns.title: Viewing measurement by OzTAM
concerns.fact: The TV looked up an OzTAM measurement name 412 times; none were blocked.
concerns.inference: A broadcaster app on the TV is probably reporting what is watched to OzTAM.
concerns.mitigation: Block oztam.com.au in Pi-hole. Some catch-up apps may refuse to play.
concerns.verify: Check that the Pi-hole query log shows the OzTAM lookups as blocked.

concerns.title: Advertising lookups
concerns.fact: All 58 lookups for Google's advertising service were blocked by Pi-hole.
concerns.inference: Apps on the TV request adverts; the block is working.
concerns.mitigation: None needed; the existing Pi-hole block covers it.
concerns.verify: Keep an eye on the blocked count staying equal to the total.

questions: Was viewing information turned on during the TV's first setup?
Which catch-up apps are used on the TV?
